GameConditionDef.label: temporal dilation
GameConditionDef.description: A tempormortis is running somewhere on this map and has been for a very long time. Everything inside the field moves, aims and strikes at a fraction of its proper speed - attackers and defenders alike. Nothing here gets to hurry.
GameConditionDef.letterText: Everything inside this field moves, aims and strikes at a fraction of its proper speed - yours as much as theirs. Nothing here gets to hurry.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The sands finish falling. Time comes back.
